title: Multi-Expert Conformal Risk Control for Pairwise LLM Judging in Open-Ended Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2608.26529v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we explore multi-expert Conformal Risk Control (CRC) algorithms for pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation in open-ended dialogue. Our core insight is that multi-expert aggregation offers a complementary remedy to CRC: whereas CRC controls risk at the decision threshold through abstention, aggregation sanitizes the scoring function at its source. Guided by this, we first design two multi-expert CRC methods: Score Averaging and Decision Voting, which aggregate at the score and decision levels, respectively. While both strategies outperform single-expert methods on homogeneous expert panels, on heterogeneous LLM judges they remain risk-valid but recover only limited coverage, because a uniform threshold cannot match the experts' distinct scoring scales. To resolve this issue, we further propose Marginal-Calibrated Conformal Consensus (MC3): it captures distinct per-expert scales via initial threshold ratios, while jointly tuning

translated_title: 多专家共形风险控制在开放式对话中成对LLM评判中的应用
translated_abstract: 本文探讨了多专家共形风险控制（CRC）算法在开放式对话中进行成对LLM-as-a-Judge评估中的应用。我们的核心见解是，多专家聚合为CRC提供了互补性的解决方案：CRC通过弃权在决策阈值处控制风险，而聚合则在源头净化评分函数。基于此，我们首先设计了两种多专家CRC方法：得分平均和决策投票，它们分别在得分和决策层面进行聚合。虽然这两种策略在同质专家小组上优于单专家方法，但在异质LLM评判者上，它们保持风险有效性但仅恢复有限的覆盖率，因为统一阈值无法匹配各专家不同的评分尺度。为解决此问题，我们进一步提出了边际校准共形共识（MC3）：它通过初始阈值比率捕获各专家特有的尺度，同时联合调整。
tldr: 本文提出多专家共形风险控制方法，并引入MC3算法，通过初始阈值比率校准异质专家评分尺度，实现开放式对话中成对LLM评判的风险控制与覆盖率优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes multi-expert Conformal Risk Control methods, introducing MC3 to calibrate heterogeneous expert scoring scales via initial threshold ratios, enhancing risk control and coverage in pairwise LLM judging.
